answer: Each agent posts a $50 identity bond decaying 10% per epoch unless verified work arrives, so a harbor of fakes sinks. Each epoch the bond is checked: work renews it, idle bonds shrink, and a lapsed identity must top up to rejoin the trusted island. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000 plus $5,000 per epoch, against a $3,000 pool share. An honest agent tops up one bond once and keeps its full share; its ivory-white record makes renewal cheap.
